notes: Not failures, but worth knowing. (1) /readyz stays HTTP 200 with ready:true while chat is 'warming' or 'failed'; the chat state is only in the 'chat' field. Chat itself returns 503 in those states, so there are no more timeouts. (2) A failed warm-up is permanent until restart; there is no retry. (3) When a known crop's own documents are all filtered out, Retriever.search falls back to the general documents and the route gives only the normal label note, without saying the guidance is general (src/sprout/web/analyses.py chat, note logic). The cited source shows it, but the response does not. (4) The user's chat message is committed to chat_messages before the 503 abort, so a rejected message is still stored. (5) A cache with the right shape but NaN content is trusted. (6) The cross-process or cross-object cold start can still embed more than once; the writes are atomic though. The main folder's T1.2 changes were not touched.
